title: Symmetric Game
body_html:
Symmetric Game

A strategic game has a symmetry $\phi$ if $\phi$ is a permutation of the player set, induces bijections $S_i\to S_{\phi(i)}$, and preserves payoffs: $$ g_{\phi(i)}(\phi(s))=g_i(s) \quad\text{for all } i\in I,\ s\in S. $$ The same permutation acts on mixed profiles by transporting probability mass along the induced bijections of strategy sets.
